heading: Give Hope. Change Lives.
intro: Every shilling you send goes directly into programmes that protect girls, mentor youth, and support mental health in Mukuru kwa Reuben. No admin bloat. Just impact.

tiers.label: Supporter
tiers.impact: Covers one youth mentorship session — a safe space, a listening ear, and a plan for the future.

tiers.label: Advocate
tiers.impact: Funds one week of mental health outreach, reaching up to 10 young people in the community.

tiers.label: Champion
tiers.impact: Sponsors one girl's safe space programme for a full month — protection, skills, and confidence.

tiers.label: Changemaker
tiers.impact: Covers a full community workshop — training, materials, and facilitator costs included.

tiers.label: Pillar
tiers.impact: Funds one month of our Women's Empowerment Circle, supporting 20+ women building livelihoods.

tiers.label: Founding Voice
tiers.impact: Transforms an entire community programme for a quarter — from planning to graduation day.
